name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - § 27/2
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: ‘calls on the Commission to do its utmost to protect the legitimate interests of final beneficiaries and to ensure that final beneficiaries can continue to benefit from Union funding in cases of breaching the rule of law by national governments, without weakening the application of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2020/2092 and while maintaining the Member States’ payment obligation under the Union law;’
